summary: Iteration 24 — Təşkilatçılıq/Fəaliyyətlər module E2E testing. 26/26 backend tests PASS (auth, dashboard stats, 7 vendor CRUD, rating create/list/delete, aggregation logic, cascade delete, RBAC for Mühasib, invalid module 404, regression for barters/projects/attendance/contact-lists). Frontend: /organization dashboard renders 8 cards with correct test-ids, /organization/venues modal opens with grouped fields (Əsas/Əlaqə/Tutum/Texniki/Catering/Şərtlər/Media) and submits successfully creating a venue, /organization/ratings shows Summary + History tabs and add-rating-btn, Sidebar 'Fəaliyyətlər' submenu with 9 items visible and expanded after navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:3207 — overall rating formula divides by 4 but only sums 4 of the 6 score fields (avg_price + avg_quality + avg_operativity + avg_behavior), excluding avg_flexibility and avg_fit. Business logic confirmation recommended: if all 6 were intended, numerator should include avg_flexibility + avg_fit and denominator become 6.

server.py ratings/summary does not use Pydantic; raw dict validation only. Input validation on /organization/ratings accepts any vendor_type outside ORG_COLLECTIONS with 400 which is correct, but score bounds (0-5) are not enforced server-side.
Route order note: /organization/ratings/* and /organization/dashboard/stats declared BEFORE /organization/{module} — correctly implemented to prevent path shadowing.
Cascade delete on vendor removal works, but there is no DELETE on /organization/ratings/{id} permission check for rating owner; only role-level write permission — acceptable for admin use case.
